messages:
tori: Starting tonight's maintenance window 22:30-23:00 UTC. Migration: backfill `customer_region` partial index on users. Will ADD COLUMN then populate with backfill to avoid heavy table rewrite. Pin api=release-2026-04-02 for rollout.
deploybot: Canary created: backfiller v1.4 on shard db-west-1. Holdpoint set after 200 rows. Health hooks attached.
ben: ack. i'll watch p95 and replica lag; will alert on sustained lag >15s.
dba: preflight looks good. Suggested backfill chunk size 1k, default rate 150/s. SQL snippet: ```CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_users_region ON users ((profile->>'customer_region')) WHERE active = true;```
infra-bot: baseline metrics pulled: p50 read 28ms, p95 210ms, replica lag median 0.8s. No current alerts.
tori: starting canary now. call out any elevated wal or unexpected locks.
deploybot: Canary progressed: 200 rows processed, no locks >400ms. escalating to batch mode 150/s. Auto-abort thresholds: replica_lag>25s or iowait>60%.
# ~5m later~
ben: seeing p95 climb to +120ms and replica lag on db-west-1-replica at 16s. Not yet over abort but trending.
dba: checking pg_stat_activity: a vacuum worker collided with checkpoint; wal write spikes observed. No blocking exclusive locks on users.
infra-bot: iowait hitting 42% on primary; checkpoint frequency increased.
tori: pause backfill at holdpoint. @deploybot pause backfiller canary.
deploybot: Pausing jobs. Checkpoint saved id=chk_1788005600. Jobs suspended.
ben: proposal: resume at 40/s and workers=1, add preflight replica catch-up probe (must be <2s lag for 1 minute).
dba: agree. Also recommend pre-seeding small sample index on a replica to warm cache before full run.
tori: apply proposed changes and keep pin. resume with slow pace only after preflight passes.
deploybot: Resuming backfill at 40/s with worker_count=1. Preflight probe running. Next healthcheck in 4m.
# ~6m later~
ben: probe passed initially but now replica lag climbed to 28s and gateway showed sporadic 504s for profile reads. This is outside acceptable canary noise.
tori: decision: abort canary and revert partial index on canary shard. Ben, prepare revert plan. We'll not DROP cluster-wide yet.
dba: Revert steps: stop backfiller jobs, run `DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_users_region` on db-west-1, VACUUM ANALYZE on users range. Will monitor wal backlog.
deploybot: Executing rollback on canary shard db-west-1. Rollback initiated ts=1788005905.
infra-bot: Post-rollback: iowait back to 8%, replica lag ~1s, API 504s cleared. No customer-facing incidents.
ben: confirmed metrics returned to baseline. Opening follow-up INF-2026 to add WAL-pressure gate, preflight cache seed, and keep lower default rate 25/s.
tori: update release notes: canary aborted -> index backfill paused due to WAL/checkpoint pressure causing replica lag; follow-up INF-2026. We'll reattempt with safer prechecks. Closing thread.
